title: Special Topics in Plant Science; Data Wrangling and Visualization with R
description: Students will learn the fundamentals of using R handle, summarize and plot data in ways that are repeatable and transparent through a combinati on of lecture, hands-on demos, and exercises. Using the approaches and philsophy of the Tidyverse you will learn workflow and coding habits that will help transform your ability to understand your data and communicate it to others. Through this course you will be fluent in the reproducible vocabulary and grammar of R.
